setup.zh: 十月十二夜里，你蹲在柴房后面，给小狰喂萝卜。柴房的门「吱呀」一声开了——马小宝，带着五个人。
setup.en: The night of the twelfth of the tenth month, you crouch behind the woodshed feeding Little Zheng a radish. The woodshed door creaks open — Ma Xiaobao, with five men.

recap.zh: 十月十二夜里，马小宝带五个人堵在柴房后面。你打得过，可你没还手——你数着，二十三下。数到二十，五个里有一个收回了脚：「……够了。」
recap.en: The night of the twelfth of the tenth month, Ma Xiaobao and five others cornered you behind the woodshed. You could have beaten them; you didn't hit back — you counted: twenty-three. At twenty, one of the five drew back his foot: "…That's enough."

zh: 十月十二，夜里，柴房后面。
马小宝来了，带着五个人。
en: The twelfth of the tenth month, night, behind the woodshed.
Ma Xiaobao is here, with five men.

label.en: The radish in Little Zheng's mouth

text.zh: 小狰嘴里叼着半截萝卜，也不知听懂了没有。
text.en: Little Zheng has half a radish in its mouth; who knows if it understood.

text.zh: 木牌凉凉的，一动不动。她睡得正沉。
text.en: The token lies cool and still. She is sound asleep.

story.zh:
十月十二夜里，月亮还差三天才圆。沈小满蹲在柴房后面，给小狰喂萝卜。他摸着它那只独角，压低了声音道：「听着。等会儿要是有人来，你别咬。咬了人，他们就要打你。打你，我就得还手。我还了手，就藏不住了。」小狰嘴里叼着半截萝卜，也不知听懂了没有。便在这时，身后的柴房门「吱呀」一声开了。

马小宝从柴房里走了出来，身上沾着好几根干草。身后一个接一个，又出来了五个人。六个人在月光底下一字排开，把柴房后面那块巴掌大的空地堵得严严实实。马小宝道：「沈小满。听说你收了只畜生？给我。」小满把小狰往身后拨了拨：「它不认生人。」马小宝道：「它认不认我不管。我认它就行。」一挥手，五个人便围了上来。

五个人围上来的工夫，小满已经过了一遍账。五个跟班，都是进门三年的老弟子，两个练气三层，三个二层；马小宝一层，是丹药硬喂出来的，虚得像一块泡了水的糕。自己也是一层，后山那块青石，他一拳下去，只崩下一块皮。打得过么？打不过。拼一个马小宝，倒拼得下来——揪住了，一拳砸在那块泡了水的糕上。可砸完了，五个人便不只是打他了：怀里这一团红毛，要叫人扯去；胸口这块木牌，也要叫人扯出来瞧瞧，什么破牌子，打起架来会烫。他打得过一个马小宝。他打不过马小宝后头的那些。
story.en:
The night of the twelfth of the tenth month the moon was still three days short of full. Shen Xiaoman squatted behind the woodshed feeding Little Zheng a radish. Stroking its horn, he lowered his voice: "Listen. If someone comes in a bit, don't bite. Bite someone, and they'll hit you. Hit you, and I'll have to hit back. Hit back, and there's no hiding." Little Zheng had half a radish in its mouth; who knew if it understood. Just then the woodshed door behind them creaked open.

Ma Xiaobao came out of the woodshed, bits of straw stuck all over him. Behind him, one after another, came five more. The six of them stood in a line in the moonlight and blocked that palm-sized patch behind the woodshed solid. Ma Xiaobao said, "Shen Xiaoman. I hear you've taken in a beast? Give it here." Xiaoman pushed Little Zheng behind him. "It won't go to strangers." Ma Xiaobao said, "I don't care if it knows me. So long as I know it." He waved, and the five closed in.

In the time it took the five to close in, Xiaoman had gone through the accounts. Five followers, all three years in: two at the third level of qi refining, three at the second; Ma Xiaobao at the first, force-fed on pills, soft as a cake left in water. Himself, the first too — on the back mountain one punch had knocked only a flake of skin off that boulder. Could he win? No. Ma Xiaobao alone he could take — get a grip on him and bring a fist down on that sodden cake. But after that it wouldn't be only him they were beating: the red bundle in his coat would be torn away, and the token on his chest pulled out for a look — what kind of junk token gets hot in a fight? He could beat one Ma Xiaobao. He couldn't beat what stood behind Ma Xiaobao.

exits.means: does not fight back, shields the fox token and counts the blows

what.zh: 十月十二，柴房：马小宝等六人，二十三下。利息，另算。
what.en: The twelfth of the tenth month, the woodshed: Ma Xiaobao and five others, twenty-three blows. Interest to be reckoned separately.

story.zh:
他把小狰一把捞起来，塞进怀里，拿衣襟裹住，蹲下身去，两只胳膊抱住了头。拳头和脚，登时像下雨一般落了下来。

头一下是马小宝踢的，踢在后背上，踢完了退回去，把桂花糕换到另一只手里。第二下到第五下，是两个三层的，一个踢左肋，一个踢右肋。踢左肋的那个，鞋头补着一块黑布。小满心里数着：二，三，四，五。再往后，就乱了。他缩成一团，把后背、屁股、两条胳膊，一样一样地让出去，只有怀里那只拼命挣扎、「咔咔」直叫的红毛团子，和胸口那块木牌，让不出去。数到十二，马小宝挤进人堆，一拳砸在他左边眼眶上。他眼前一黑，跟着一亮，左边的天地只剩了一半。

有人伸手来扯他怀里的小狰，手刚摸到毛，小狰便一口咬在那人虎口上，那人「嗷」的一声，缩回了手。马小宝蹲下来，在他腰上、怀里、袖筒里摸了个遍：「令呢？巡夜令呢？」没摸着，在他背上捣了两拳。数到十九，那块黑布又到了，踹在他左边肋下，「咯」的一声，他听见了，那是从自己身子里头传出来的。

数到二十，那一下没有落下来。五个人里，一个瘦瘦的、一直站在最外头的，脚抬起来，又放下了，声音很低：「……够了。」

是老蔫，马小宝身后那个不吭声的。小满只知道他是马家佃户的儿子。马小宝回过头，看了他一眼。老蔫把头低下去了，可那只脚，没有再抬起来。

第二十一下，第二十二下。第二十三下，又是马小宝踢的。他走上前来，看了看地上蹲着的这一团，最后一脚，不轻不重，踢在小满的肩膀上，倒像是给这件事盖了个戳。

踢这一脚的时候，小满正好从胳膊缝里，拿那只还睁得开的右眼，看了马小宝一眼。他原以为，马小宝踢人的时候，脸上该是得意的。可马小宝的脸，在月光底下，是皱着的，眼睛还在他怀里、腰上来回地找，像一个翻遍了箱子、没找着东西的人。小满那时候还不懂这是什么意思。他只是记下了。

马小宝喘着粗气，啐了一口：「不认主的畜生，我要它何用？留着给你养。」走出两步，又回过头来：「月底盘账。你趴在铺上这半个月，药园夜里要是丢了点什么——」他没说完，带着五个人走了。老蔫走在最后，没回头。

柴房后面，又只剩了一个人和一只狰。沈小满慢慢地，把抱着头的两只胳膊放下来，身子一歪，仰面躺倒在了泥地里。泥是凉的，湿的。他嘴里一股血腥味，是咬破了舌头。左边眼睛肿得睁不开，肋骨那儿，一吸气就疼，吸得深了，疼得眼前发白。他试了几回，找着了一个不深不浅的口子，便照着那个口子，一口一口地喘。

他躺着，把马小宝那半句没说完的话，在心里续完了。他爬不起来，药园里自然会丢东西——那只狰不偷了，自会有别的「狰」去偷。月底周衡翻开账簿，巡夜令、残株，便一样一样，都回马家手里去了。还手，藏不住；不还手，躺半个月，药园丢了。

小狰从他怀里钻了出来，抖了抖一身炸开的毛，爬到他胸口上，低下头，拿它那只独角，一下一下，轻轻地顶他的脸。那角顶在他肿起来的眼眶上，疼。他没躲。
story.en:
He scooped up Little Zheng, stuffed it in his coat, wrapped his lapel round it, squatted down, and wrapped both arms round his head. Fists and feet came down at once like rain.

The first was Ma Xiaobao's kick, in the back; then he stepped away and moved the cake to his other hand. The second to fifth came from the two third-levels, one at his left ribs, one at his right ribs. The one at his left ribs had a patch of black cloth on the toe of his shoe. Xiaoman counted: two, three, four, five. After that it fell apart. He curled into a ball; his back, his rump, both arms he gave up one by one; only the frantic, chittering red bundle in his coat, and the token on his chest, he could not give up. At twelve Ma Xiaobao squeezed in and brought a fist down on his left eye socket. His sight went black, then bright, and the left half of the world was gone.

Someone grabbed for Little Zheng in his coat. The hand had barely touched fur when Little Zheng bit the web of the thumb, and the man yelped and snatched his hand back. Ma Xiaobao squatted and felt all over Xiaoman's waist, coat and sleeves. "Where's the token? The night-watch token?" Finding nothing, he punched him twice in the back. At nineteen the black patch came again, driving into his left side, and there was a *crack* — he heard it, and it came from inside his own body.

At twenty, the blow didn't fall. Of the five, a thin one who had stood at the very edge all along lifted his foot and put it down again, and said, very low: "…That's enough."

It was Laonian, the one who never said a word behind Ma Xiaobao. All Xiaoman knew of him was that he was a Ma tenant's son. Ma Xiaobao turned and looked at him. Laonian dropped his head. But that foot did not lift again.

Twenty-one, twenty-two. The twenty-third was Ma Xiaobao's again. He came forward, looked at the huddle on the ground, and the last kick, neither light nor hard, landed on Xiaoman's shoulder — as though stamping a seal on the whole affair.

As that kick landed, Xiaoman happened to look up at Ma Xiaobao through the gap between his arms, with the one eye still open. He had thought Ma Xiaobao's face, kicking, would be gloating. But in the moonlight Ma Xiaobao's face was screwed up, his eyes still searching Xiaoman's coat and waist, back and forth, like a man who has turned out every chest and not found the thing. Xiaoman didn't understand then what it meant. He only noted it.

Ma Xiaobao, breathing hard, spat. "A beast that won't take a master — what use is it to me? Keep it." Two steps off he turned back. "Month-end accounts. You'll be lying in your bunk half a month, and if anything goes missing from the herb garden at night —" He didn't finish; he left with the five. Laonian walked last, and didn't look back.

Behind the woodshed there was only a boy and a zheng again. Shen Xiaoman slowly lowered the arms from round his head, tipped over, and lay on his back in the mud. The mud was cold and wet. His mouth tasted of blood — he'd bitten his tongue. His left eye was swollen shut; at his ribs every breath hurt, and a deep one turned his sight white. He tried a few times and found an opening neither deep nor shallow, and breathed through that, breath by breath.

Lying there, he finished the sentence Ma Xiaobao had left half said. If he couldn't get up, things would naturally go missing from the herb garden — the zheng wouldn't steal any more, but some other "zheng" would. At month's end Zhou Heng would open the ledger, and the night-watch token and the culls would go back into Ma hands one by one. Hit back, and no hiding; don't hit back, lie half a month, and lose the garden.

Little Zheng crawled out of his coat, shook out its bristling fur, climbed onto his chest, bent its head, and with its one horn nudged his face, gently, again and again. The horn pressed on his swollen eye socket; it hurt. He didn't pull away.

exits.means: clenches the fists, nearly fights back
